title: Evidence Section Output
description: Structured output schema for the evidence section content extraction. Typed unit arrays: measures, experiment_setups, findings. Valid unit types: Measure, ExperimentSetup, Finding. Authors relations.

anchor_id.description: ID of the unit that anchors this section; it must be defined in one typed unit array

measures.description: Measure units extracted for this section

id.description: Unit identifier in lowercase prefix:descriptor format

provenance.description: Location markers for this unit: top-level section anchors such as ['\u00a71', '\u00a72']

unit.description: Non-empty measurement unit such as %, ms, BLEU, F1, perplexity, or unitless

setup_ids.description: IDs of local ExperimentSetup units scoping this measure; empty when none apply

comparison_direction.description: Whether higher or lower values are preferred; omit when unspecified

variant.description: System name for this score row as the paper labels it — a method-family variant/configuration or a compared-against baseline (e.g. 'Transformer (big)', 'GNMT')

value.description: Reported score encoded as a string, including numeric values

system_id.description: ID of the Method unit this row reports — the contribution variant or the compared-against baseline (e.g. 'mth:transformer', 'mth:gnmt'). Empty string when no node represents this row's system (e.g. an ensemble-of-baselines the census did not capture).

setup_id.description: ID of the local ExperimentSetup unit this row was measured under — the dataset/split/protocol (e.g. 'exp:wmt14_ende'). This is how the row binds to its data. Empty string when the measure's own setup_ids already scope every row.

scores.description: Flat array of reported scores under this measure — one row per system, covering the method family's own variants and every compared-against baseline

experiment_setups.description: ExperimentSetup units extracted for this section

id.description: Unit identifier in lowercase prefix:descriptor format

provenance.description: Location markers for this unit: top-level section anchors such as ['\u00a71', '\u00a72']

role.description: Which experimental ingredient this is — a substrate the method is tried on (dataset/benchmark/task) or a configuration that scopes a measure (data_split/inference_protocol/training_config/ensembling/population)

name.description: Name/label of the setup — a dataset name, a split label, a configuration name

description.description: Optional one-sentence prose describing the setup; empty string when the name suffices

findings.description: Finding units extracted for this section

id.description: Unit identifier in lowercase prefix:descriptor format

provenance.description: Location markers for this unit: top-level section anchors such as ['\u00a71', '\u00a72']

statement.description: The finding as a single declarative sentence

relations.description: Edges this evidence section authors. Lifted into the global relations[] during assembly. Empty array when none apply.

relation.description: about = a Finding is about a Method/ExperimentSetup/Measure; supports = a Measure or Finding supports a Finding.

provenance.description: Location markers for this unit: top-level section anchors such as ['\u00a71', '\u00a72']
